title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: Late show. Recorded by Jim Cooper from seat # BB 108 (2nd row Center) Hitachi trq-222, 2 Hitachi mikes; Transferred  >  sony d5pro2 > dbx 2231 EQ > sony rcd w500c

ai_review.summary: Great audience tape that captures an iconic Dark Star and a mind‑blowing Other One, with generally clear sound and full‑show completeness.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this performance, singling out the Dark Star as possibly the greatest ever played and praising the surreal climax of The Other One and the closing Walking‑in‑Jordan version of We Bid You Goodnight. The audience recording is described as “pretty good” and complete, with no major audio complaints, making it an enjoyable listen despite not being a soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviews are highly positive (4‑5 stars), highlighting exceptional musical moments and noting only that the audience recording is decent, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape described as 'pretty good AUD' with full show present; no significant dropouts or muffling mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight the third‑set peak with The Other One and a special closing version of We Bid You Goodnight, noting the show’s overall magic and its personal significance to many listeners.

band_member_comments.Drums: One reviewer describes a unique drum moment that creates an illusion of sound spilling over, indicating a memorable percussion section.
